worked_solution:
Taking the antiderivative and evaluating the difference at the bounds, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{2}{8}^{x}\,\text{d}x & =\frac{{8}^{x}}{\operatorname{ln}⁡8}{|}_{1}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{\operatorname{ln}⁡8}\cdot {8}^{x}\,{|}_{1}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{\operatorname{ln}⁡8}({8}^{2}-{8}^{1}) \\  & =\frac{1}{\operatorname{ln}⁡8}(64-8) \\  & =\frac{56}{\operatorname{ln}⁡8}.\end{aligned}
$$
